info.title: Project Service API
info.description:
eGov DIGIT Project service - manages Projects, Project-Beneficiary/Facility/Staff/Resource linkages, field Tasks, ad-hoc field UserActions and on-device Location Capture, plus a bandwidth-check utility endpoint.

**Authentication**: this service does not use a separate `Authorization` HTTP header. Every request body embeds a `RequestInfo` object whose `authToken` field carries the Bearer JWT issued by egov-user (obtained by calling egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login` API). Downstream services validate this embedded token together with `RequestInfo.userInfo` (uuid, userName, roles) to authenticate and authorize the caller.

**Errors**: non-2xx responses follow egov-tracer's default `CustomException` handling shape - see the `ErrorRes` schema - and are returned with HTTP 400 unless otherwise noted per-operation.

Role.description: Role assigned to a user in a given tenant, as returned by egov-user.

User.description: Authenticated user embedded in RequestInfo.userInfo. Obtained from egov-user's /user/oauth/token or /user/_login response.

PlainAccessRequest.description: Optional plain-text field access request used by egov's PII masking layer.

RequestInfo.description: Standard eGov DIGIT request envelope embedded in every request body. Authentication is performed via `authToken` (the Bearer JWT obtained from egov-user's `/user/oauth/token` or `/user/_login` API) carried inside this object, together with `userInfo` describing the authenticated user and their roles. There is no separate `Authorization` header scheme in this service - the token embedded here IS the credential checked by downstream services.

authToken.description: Bearer JWT auth token obtained from egov-user OAuth login. This is the actual authentication credential for the request.

Error.description: A single error entry, as produced by egov-tracer's default CustomException handling.

description.example: tenantId provided is invalid or does not exist

ErrorRes.description: Standard error response shape returned (HTTP 400) by egov-tracer's default CustomException / ExceptionAdvise handling.

description.example: Installation of solar street lighting across City A wards
